# Vendored libraries

Used by the built-in Word (.docx) view (`ui/docx-view.js`) and the PDF view
(`ui/pdf-view.js`), served to the content view from inside condor.exe.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docx-preview.min.js` | [docx-preview](https://github.com/VolodymyrBaydalka/docxjs) | 0.4.1 | Apache-2.0 (`docx-preview.LICENSE`) |
| `jszip.min.js` | [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) | 3.10.1 | MIT, used under the MIT option of its MIT-or-GPLv3 dual licence (`jszip.LICENSE.md`) |
| `pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs`, `pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs` | [pdf.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) (`pdfjs-dist`) | 4.10.38 | Apache-2.0 (`pdfjs/LICENSE`) |
